interval_take: Dhurandhar: The Revenge has delivered the greatest opening week in Hindi cinema history. Every weekday metric has broken its previous record. D5 Monday locked at ₹60 Cr — beating Tiger 3's holiday-aided ₹59.25 Cr and Pushpa 2's non-holiday ₹46.40 Cr. D6 Tuesday held at ~₹49 Cr, a –13% drop that the trade is calling exceptional. D0–D6 India nett: ₹563.12 Cr. Worldwide gross: ₹919 Cr in six days. Deadline reported $81M 5-day global — second biggest Indian opening ever behind Pushpa 2. In North America, $14M 5-day at 987 sites is the all-time Bollywood NA record. D7 Wednesday pending confirmation tonight; Boxoffy call ~₹50 Cr with Ram Navami holiday D8 Thursday expected to push week 1 total above ₹610 Cr nett. Ustaad Bhagat Singh has confirmed its flop status at ~₹63 Cr 6-day nett against ₹105+ Cr AP/TG distribution cost — the clearest casualty of D2's dominance. Thaai Kizhavi exits to JioHotstar on March 26 as a SUPER HIT: ₹57 Cr nett on ₹9 Cr budget.
